description:
Extra Space Asia Self-Storage
Founded in 2007, Extra Space Asia has grown into one of the region’s leading self‑storage providers. From our beginnings in key Asian cities, we now operate a regional network of 100+ facilities and 30,000+ storage units across seven gateway cities.
Our facilities support both households and businesses, providing secure, professionally managed environments for personal belongings, commercial inventory, and essential documents.
Sustainability is central to our mission. Extra Space Asia proudly holds dual international certifications—Green Certification and recognition from the Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark (GRESB)—reflecting our commitment to ESG principles and responsible growth.

Manage Storage & Workspace Anytime, Anywhere
With the Extra Space app, you’re always in control. Reserve storage units, book workspaces, select value added services, manage payments, and access your account—all in one convenient platform.
Whether you need personal storage, business inventory space, or a shared workspace, the Extra Space app makes it simple to find and manage the right solution. Designed for flexibility, the app keeps you connected on the go.

Key Features
Easy Self-Storage & Workspace Reservations
Quickly search, reserve, and book self-storage units or private office suites near you. Find the right size or workspace in just a few taps.

Manage Storage Anytime, Anywhere
View your storage unit details, manage bookings, and access your account in real time — directly from your phone.

Secure In‑App Payments
Pay your rental securely. Set up recurring payments, track payment history, and receive reminders so you never miss a due date.

Secure Storage Facilities
Your belongings are protected with modern security systems, including 24/7 surveillance cameras and controlled access, giving you complete peace of mind.

Flexible Storage Options
Choose from a wide range of solutions — from small personal lockers to large business storage units and specialised storage types such as wine, air-con and dehumidified.

Download the Extra Space app today and enjoy a smarter way to manage your storage and workspace anytime, anywhere.
